scope: Preserve V8U through V9D, verify lawful access routes for exact NIST, GE and Boeing records, and classify public primary-source analogue datasets and validated-model reports by physical proximity. Authorize no WTC coupon, projectile rupture, facade impact, whole-aircraft, global tower, thermal or Blender physics calculation.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: A statement transcribed from an identified government, manufacturer, university or research-repository source.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: A result reported by an identified government-sponsored model or test programme; it is not a V9E result.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: No local-archive claim is introduced and the source archive is not rescanned.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: The tier definitions and documentary usability gates declared in this file.
evidence_policy.derived_result: A deterministic classification and completeness check over the declared source records.
evidence_policy.unknown: Exact WTC room-temperature high-rate channels and production CF6-80A2/Boeing 767 material, joint and fracture data remain unknown.

official_sources.direct_fact: DOJ guidance states that generally any person may make a FOIA request, including a non-U.S. citizen.
The DOJ OIP infographic states that any person, regardless of citizenship, can make a FOIA request.
NIST provides its official written-request route and identifies its FOIA office.

foia_eligibility.limitation: Eligibility does not establish that a record exists, is retained, is non-exempt, is releasable without redaction, or is available without fees.

A.definition: Exact target material or component, exact relevant loading/rate regime, traceable test metadata and usable numerical records.
A.permitted_use: May contribute to target-specific component validation only after independent quality and uncertainty gates pass.

B.definition: One exact or close physical dimension: exact WTC material in another regime, or comparable structural steel with relevant rate/failure data.
B.permitted_use: Material-law, signal-reduction and regularization method benchmarking only; no WTC material identification.

C.definition: Generic homologous engine, fan, projectile or containment experiment/model under impact loading.
C.permitted_use: Contact, breakup, energy, momentum and mesh-method benchmarking only; no production CF6-80A2 identification.

D.definition: Generic aircraft panel, crash-model or open finite-element workflow with materially different geometry, material or impact speed.
D.permitted_use: File, mesh, joint and reproducibility workflow checks only.

proprietary_source_access_matrix.identifier_status: Twelve specimen identifiers and five raw channel families are defined in V9D.
proprietary_source_access_matrix.lawful_access_route: NIST FOIA Office; use the unsent V9D draft only after explicit authorization.
proprietary_source_access_matrix.limitation: The route is confirmed but record existence, retention and release status are unknown.

proprietary_source_access_matrix.identifier_status: The current GE technical-manual index identifies GEK 50460 as the CF6-80A/A2 Installation Manual, revision 2 dated 1983-09-01.
proprietary_source_access_matrix.lawful_access_route: GE Fleet Support, as identified by the manufacturer manual index.
proprietary_source_access_matrix.limitation: An installation-manual identifier is not a component alloy, layup, dynamic constitutive law or fracture card.

proprietary_source_access_matrix.owner_or_custodian: GE Aerospace; incorporated by reference by FAA AD 2021-26-22
proprietary_source_access_matrix.identifier_status: FAA AD 2021-26-22 identifies GE CF6-80A SB 72-0869 R03 dated 2021-03-19 for specified HPT disk inspections.
proprietary_source_access_matrix.lawful_access_route: GE normal service-information channel; the public FAA AD remains an identifier and regulatory description.
proprietary_source_access_matrix.limitation: The bulletin concerns HPT disk inspection and does not supply a reusable cowling, attachment or complete impact-fracture model.

proprietary_source_access_matrix.identifier_status: Boeing publicly identifies AMM, IPC, SRM and service bulletins as controlled technical-publication families in its Toolbox Library.
proprietary_source_access_matrix.lawful_access_route: Boeing Maintenance Performance Toolbox Library or Boeing Service Bulletin Center for authorized customers.
proprietary_source_access_matrix.limitation: No public tail-specific 767-200 CF6-80A2 nacelle/cowling manual, vendor mapping, joint card or failure dataset was located.

proprietary_source_access_matrix.identifier_status: Boeing describes a secure catalog for authorized customers to discover, request and buy technical publications, drawings and engineering data.
proprietary_source_access_matrix.lawful_access_route: Boeing Data & Services Marketplace through MyBoeingFleet.
proprietary_source_access_matrix.limitation: A commercial access route does not establish that the requested legacy 767 records are available or licensable for this investigation.

open_analogue_sources.title: High-temperature tensile data for recovered WTC structural steel
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: Recovered WTC steel, but high-temperature quasistatic tests rather than the required room-temperature high-rate regime.
open_analogue_sources.permitted_use: Exact-material provenance and data-schema cross-check only.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: Cannot identify the missing room-temperature 65-417 per second response or high-rate fracture/localization parameters.

open_analogue_sources.title: Validation and implementation of bridge design specifications for barge impact loading
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: ASTM A36 and A1011 mild structural steels, not WTC M26/C80 steel.
open_analogue_sources.permitted_use: Rate-law fitting, stress-strain reduction and LS-DYNA implementation benchmark.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: The official report describes rates through 500 per second while the companion journal abstract states through 250 per second; published curves/parameters are not the missing WTC raw channels.

open_analogue_sources.title: Intermediate strain-rate response of A572-50 and A992 structural steel
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: Modern structural steels A572-50 and A992, not WTC M26/C80 steel.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: The published range reaches 2 per second, far below the 65-417 per second WTC channels.

open_analogue_sources.title: Tensile and compressive behaviour of S355 mild steel in a wide range of strain rates
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: S355 mild steel, not WTC M26/C80 steel.
open_analogue_sources.permitted_use: Cowper-Symonds and Johnson-Cook rate-law comparison benchmark.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: The publication record does not provide the required WTC raw channels or a production-engine material mapping.

open_analogue_sources.title: Split Hopkinson Pressure Bar investigations of steel S355 specimens and complementary characterization methods
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: S355 notched hat-shaped shear specimens, not WTC tensile specimens or CF6 components.
open_analogue_sources.permitted_use: Signal-chain, shear-localization and nonlocal-regularization benchmark after a separate data-ingestion gate.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: The data emphasize adiabatic shear localization rather than uniaxial tensile fracture. The 955 MB supplementary archive was not downloaded in V9E.

open_analogue_sources.title: Structural metallic material coupon database
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: Multiple structural metals with raw force, displacement and time records; not WTC-specific and primarily quasistatic/cyclic.
open_analogue_sources.permitted_use: Open coupon-data ingestion and true-stress/true-strain processing benchmark.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: Does not cover the target WTC high-rate regime.

open_analogue_sources.title: Generic gas turbine fan blade-out full-fan rig model
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: Generic full-fan rig, not a fully installed production CF6-80A2 engine or Boeing 767 nacelle.
open_analogue_sources.permitted_use: Released-blade contact, containment, energy-balance and post-containment method benchmark.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: The public report was located but no public LS-DYNA input deck or production component card was found.

open_analogue_sources.title: Transient finite element analyses developed to model fan containment impact events
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: Generic fan blade-root projectile and contoured metal panels.
open_analogue_sources.permitted_use: Contact and containment FE/test comparison method benchmark.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: Not traceable to a production CF6-80A2/Boeing 767 component.

open_analogue_sources.title: Fan containment metal impact experiments and finite-element analysis
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: Generic projectile impacts on candidate containment metals.
open_analogue_sources.permitted_use: Generic metal-panel impact and deformation benchmark.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: No production CF6-80A2 component mapping or public reusable input deck was identified.

open_analogue_sources.title: Kevlar and Zylon fan containment material-model benchmark
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: Generic fabric containment tests and models.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: Cannot establish the production cowling construction or its attachments.

open_analogue_sources.title: Lightweight containment concept for a CF6-size engine
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: CF6-size concept only; not the production CF6-80A2 installation.
open_analogue_sources.permitted_use: Containment-concept geometry and mass sensitivity only.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: Size similarity is not production material or joint traceability.

open_analogue_sources.title: Fokker F28 fuselage-section LS-DYNA model compared with full-scale drop tests
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: Fokker F28 fuselage crash model at much lower speed, not Boeing 767 facade impact.
open_analogue_sources.permitted_use: Full-scale aircraft crash-model verification workflow only.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: Wrong aircraft, geometry, materials and velocity regime.

open_analogue_sources.title: EMST Panel 1 finite-element model and supporting data
open_analogue_sources.target_traceability: Modern single-aisle fuselage panel with different alloys and laminates, not Boeing 767-200 CF6-80A2 impact geometry.
open_analogue_sources.permitted_use: Open aircraft-panel mesh, joint, file-provenance and reproducibility workflow benchmark.
open_analogue_sources.limitation: Not a high-speed impact validation case and not physically transferable to the WTC target.

interpretation: V9E validates a bounded evidence and access matrix, not WTC impact physics. Official DOJ sources confirm that non-U.S. citizenship does not bar a FOIA request, while the NIST, GE and Boeing routes remain unsent and no proprietary record is acquired. Public sources provide comparable structural-steel rate data, S355 shear-localization data, generic fan-containment experiments and open aircraft-panel workflows, but no source satisfies the exact target gate. These sources may support a separately gated analogue data-ingestion and numerical-method benchmark only. They cannot supply the missing WTC M26/C80 high-rate channels or the production CF6-80A2/Boeing 767 material, joint and fracture card, which remains 0 of 9. No solver or impact is run.
